invariants.rationale: The method always returns a LinkedHashMap, which is never null.
If the input list is null, the result is an empty map due to streaming an empty collection.
All HoodieRecords in the result map originated from the input dedupedRecords list.
Every HoodieRecord in result comes from dedupedRecords, so the sum of all grouped records cannot exceed the original list size.
Every key in the resulting map corresponds to at least one record in dedupedRecords mapped to that key by the given partitioner.
